cross_verification.note_en: The Suriname Ministry of Foreign Affairs (gov.sr) publishes the visa/entry-fee procedure (visa requirement abolished for many nationalities since 1 July 2022, applications processed via VFS Global since 2019, entry fee USD/EUR 50) but this official page does not state photo dimensions, background color, or other photo specifications. Direct fetch attempts on embassies.gov.sr, foreignaffairs.gov.sr, burgerzaken.gov.sr, and cbb.gov.sr either returned 403/DNS errors or pages with no photo specifications. A Consulate General passport-application PDF (embassies.gov.sr) reportedly contains detailed photo criteria referenced by third parties, but the PDF returned as encoded/unreadable and its content could not be independently verified. Third-party photo-service sites (visafoto.com, idphotodiy.com, mybiometricphotos.com) claim 35x45mm with light/gray background, but none of this could be traced to a readable Surinamese government source, so per the verification policy it is excluded from verified data.
